content.short: MANTRA is a regulated DeFi DEX on MANTRA Chain enabling 24/7 trading of digital assets and tokenized RWAs on a self-custodial exchange.
content.description: MANTRA is a regulated decentralized exchange operating on MANTRA Chain, a security-first platform designed to comply with and enforce real-world regulatory requirements. The MANTRA DEX provides 24/7 trading of a broad range of assets—from altcoins to tokenized real-world assets—on a self-custodial exchange. It features yield-bearing DeFi products built around a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) that enables swaps and tokenized trading of traditional financial instruments such as debt, commodities, and other RWAs.
content.meta: MANTRA offers a regulated DEX on MANTRA Chain, a security-first RWA Layer 1 Blockchain. Discover MANTRA and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
